# psycopg2 (and the pinned ansible-core itself) live in the invoking user's
# site-packages, which the scratch HOME hides: without this the replay's
# psycopg2 gate fires before the port option parse and the case would pin
# the wrong failure. Same pin the capture harness uses (it discovers the
# tree at capture time; the replay needs it spelled out).
PYTHONPATH=/home/labros/.local/lib/python3.13/site-packages
# community.postgresql's own `from ansible.module_utils._text import
# to_native` makes real ansible print an import deprecation warning on
# stderr that krikri (no Python module) can never reproduce. Unrelated to
# the wording this case pins, so silence it for both capture and replay
# (same as 1750).
ANSIBLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS=False
